alert.subject: {$headline}: {$issue} {$timezone}
alert.vote_similarity_body: Vote similarity did not run this period, so reader votes had no effect on this digest. The digest was published unfiltered. The embedding API refused the request: HTTP {$status} {$detail}. This repeats every run until the embedding key or its permissions are fixed.
error.no_settings_store: this deployment has no settings store to write
feed_check.already_listed: This feed is already in the list as {$name}.
feed_check.encoded: {$url} answered in a compressed form the check did not ask for. Paste the feed's own address.
feed_check.http_status: {$url} answered HTTP {$status}. Check the address, or paste the feed's own address.
feed_check.no_articles: The feed at {$url} has no articles, so there is nothing to read from it yet.
feed_check.no_feed_link: The page at {$url} links no RSS or Atom feed. Find the feed's own address on the site and paste that.
feed_check.not_a_feed: {$url} is not an RSS or Atom feed. Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page that links one.
feed_check.not_a_url: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
feed_check.not_public: {$url} is on a private or local network, which this check does not fetch. Paste a public feed's address.
feed_check.too_large: The answer from {$url} is too large to be a feed. Paste the feed's own address.
feed_check.too_many_redirects: {$url} redirects too many times. Paste the feed's own address.
feed_check.unreachable: Could not reach {$url} ({$reason}). Check the address and try again.
index.description: Every issue of a Cyris digest: the articles worth reading from a set of RSS feeds and newsletters, newest first.
index.empty: No digests yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} to generate your first digest.
index.heading: Every {#em}issue{/em}
index.interest: See the {#link}Interest map{/link} of the tags you vote on.
index.intro: Cyris collects articles from RSS feeds and newsletters and selects the ones worth reading into a digest. Newest first. Each issue has the digest and the full list of articles it judged.
interest.description: The tags of the articles you voted on in Cyris, joined where they appear together, with how much of each suppression clock is left.
interest.empty: No voted article carries a tag yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} after you vote on articles.
interest.failed: Could not draw the interest map: {$reason}
interest.heading: What the {#em}map{/em} holds
interest.holds_elsewhere: Suppressions are active, but none is near a tag on this map.
interest.intro: The tags of the articles you voted on, joined where they appear together.
interest.label: Interest
interest.legend: Lit = suppressed now; dimmer = less time left; half colour = not suppressed.
interest.no_store: The interest map reads votes and holds from the SQL store: this deployment's [store] backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1".
issue.degraded: Some or all of this issue is unscored or plain excerpts: the configured LLM could not be used for every step this run. Check the provider and its key on Settings.
labels.access_not_set_up: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.
labels.all_answered: Every item is answered. Run cyris labels report for the result.
labels.hint: Swipe left for down, right for up. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.
labels.lede: Each card is an article the filter judged, without its verdict. Up if you want articles like it, down if not.
labels.not_drawn: No sample is drawn yet. Run cyris labels draw first.
labels.page_description: Blind labels for a Cyris deployment: one sampled article at a time, without the pipeline's verdict.
labels.signed_out: Your session has ended, so the answer was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.
labels.title: Label it {#em}blind{/em}
labels.unanswered: No answer from the server, so the answer may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
mail.footer_links: {#archive}Archive{/archive} · {#settings}Settings{/settings} — mail goes to the address set on Settings
mail.generated_by_cost: Generated by {#link}Cyris{/link} · {$tokens} tokens · {$calls} api calls · cost ${$cost}
mail.publish_failed: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no page to open.
mail.publish_failed_text: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no link.
mail.subject: Digest for {$issue}
notify.degraded: Degraded digest: the configured LLM could not be used this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.
notify.degraded_model: Degraded digest: LLM {$model} could not be used for every step this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.
onboarding.added_some_next: Press Next to try again, or Skip to go on without them.
onboarding.advanced: Advanced: embedder, digest and pipeline, defaults shown
onboarding.building: Building the first issue: {$elapsed} so far. It usually takes a few minutes. You can leave with Finish: the issue still reaches the archive.
onboarding.cards_failed: {$reason} Press Skip to go on without votes, or reload the page to try again.
onboarding.cards_no_sources: There are no feeds to draw from yet. Press Back to pick some, or Next to go on.
onboarding.cards_none: There is no article to vote on yet. Press Next to go on: the first issue works without votes.
onboarding.cards_poll_failed: The feeds could not be fetched just now ({$reason}), so these cards are only what had been fetched before.
onboarding.discord_webhook_help: Paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists.
onboarding.email_to_needed: Enter the address the digest is sent to, too.
onboarding.feeds_load_failed: Could not load the feed list: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.
onboarding.fetching_cards: Fetching the latest articles from your feeds. This can take a minute or two…
onboarding.first_issue_lede: Build an issue now from your feeds and votes, instead of waiting for the next publish hour. It runs as a scheduled issue does, notifications included, and Skip leaves the first issue to that hour.
onboarding.gone: No longer in the feed · not recorded
onboarding.hours_help: Whole hours from 0 to 23, in the timezone of the step before; half hours are refused.
onboarding.intro: Seven steps to your first issue. Skip any of them: a skipped step keeps its current value, and everything here can be changed later in Settings.
onboarding.issue_built: Your first issue is built. This deployment publishes no site, so it reached you only through its notifications.
onboarding.issue_published: Your first issue is published. {#read}Read it{/read}, or find it with every later issue in the {#archive}archive{/archive}.
onboarding.language_lede: The language each issue is written in, and the clock its publish hours are read in.
onboarding.model_hint_check: Next makes one real call to the provider first, so a typo is refused here.
onboarding.model_hint_none: No model is called: digests list plain excerpts.
onboarding.model_hint_pick: Pick a provider whose key is present.
onboarding.model_lede: The model that writes headlines and summaries, from the providers this machine has a key for. Keys stay in .env, never here.
onboarding.no_key: No provider has its key here. Set one of {$variables} in .env, then restart: under compose run docker compose up -d --force-recreate, under uv start cyris triage-ui again. Or keep None.
onboarding.no_reason: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.
onboarding.no_reason_reload: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Reload the page to try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.
onboarding.notify_lede: Where a finished issue is announced. Leave both empty to be notified nowhere.
onboarding.opening_claim: Too much, too fast. I’ll hold it for you; {#em}you{/em} say what matters.
onboarding.own_added: {$name} is under Your feeds, checked: Next adds it with the others.
onboarding.own_feed_help: A feed's address, or a site's home page that links one. It is named by the feed's own title.
onboarding.own_listed: {$name} is already listed, and is checked there.
onboarding.page_description: The guided setup of a new Cyris deployment: language, publish hours, sources, votes, notifications, the model and the first issue.
onboarding.paste_first: Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page, first.
onboarding.pick_provider: Pick a provider whose key is present, or None.
onboarding.picked_slow: The Votes step fetches every picked feed before it deals cards: up to {$slow} take about a minute, and more take longer.
onboarding.plan_no_sources: There are no sources yet, so there is nothing to build an issue from. Press Back to pick some, or Finish and add them later under Sources in Settings.
onboarding.plan_published: The issue of the latest publish hour, dated {$date}, is already published, and one built now would replace it. Read it in the archive.
onboarding.plan_started: The first issue was started from this page.
onboarding.plan_today: Start builds the first issue now. It takes a few minutes, and no later issue today replaces it.
onboarding.plan_yesterday: Start builds the first issue now, dated yesterday: neither of today's publish hours, {$hours} {$timezone}, has begun, and an issue dated today would be replaced by them. It takes a few minutes.
onboarding.run_error: The run stopped with an error.
onboarding.run_failed_next: Press Try again, or Finish to leave: the next publish hour brings an issue either way.
onboarding.run_no_articles: None of your feeds had an article in the window the run reads.
onboarding.run_no_pending: Every article in the window was already decided, so the run had nothing new.
onboarding.run_publish_failed: The issue was built, but publishing it to the archive failed.
onboarding.run_timed_out: No run has ended in {$minutes} minutes, so this one did not start or stopped without a record. Its log is in the app Worker's logs.
onboarding.schedule_lede: When each day's two issues are published.
onboarding.session_expired: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
onboarding.settings_load_failed: Could not load settings: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.
onboarding.settings_not_loaded: The settings did not load. Reload the page.
onboarding.sources_feeds_lede: The feeds of the topics you picked. Check the ones you read; Back changes the topics.
onboarding.sources_had: This deployment already has sources. Add more later under Sources in Settings; Next moves on.
onboarding.sources_topics_lede: The feeds this deployment reads, each a publisher's own feed. Pick the topics you follow; Next shows their feeds.
onboarding.timezone_detected: Detected from this browser, and not saved yet: Next saves it.
onboarding.title: Set up {#em}cyris{/em}
onboarding.topics_hint: Pick topics to see their feeds. Next with none picked goes straight to adding your own feed.
onboarding.unreachable: Could not reach cyris ({$reason}). Check the connection and try again.
onboarding.vote_similarity_off: Vote similarity is still off, so votes have no effect yet: {$reason} Turn it on under Model in Settings.
onboarding.votes_lede: A few older articles from your feeds: mark the ones you would read and the ones you would not, and leave the rest. Next records each mark as a vote, so the first issue leaves those articles out.

raw.hint: Swipe left for down, right for up; with the card focused, ← and → do the same. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.
raw.intro: Everything the run decided on, plus what is still pending. The digest shows a selection of it.
raw.title: Raw

settings.answered_without_reason: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.
settings.areas_intro: The areas the model files each article under, and the proposals waiting for you.
settings.assign_no_sources: No sources yet. {#link}Add one under Sources{/link}.
settings.assign_partial: {$error} — {$landed} of {$total} sources assigned. Save again for the rest.
settings.clef_needs_votes: Clef needs vote similarity on, under Model.
settings.digest_intro: When issues are published, what each one holds, and how large its text reads.
settings.effort_hint: How hard the model thinks before it answers; more costs more tokens and time. Default keeps each provider's own level, except low on OpenAI; Workers AI always runs at low, and Save checks the level with one call.
settings.heading: How cyris {#em}runs{/em}
settings.hours_hint: Whole hours from 0 to 23, in the timezone below; half hours are refused.
settings.load_areas_failed: Could not load areas: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.
settings.load_settings_failed: Could not load settings: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.
settings.load_sources_failed: Could not load sources: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.
settings.load_topics_failed: Could not load topics: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.
settings.missing_notice: Not set yet: {$labels}. The next run stops until they are saved.
settings.model_hint_call: Saving makes one real call to the provider first, so a typo is rejected here.
settings.model_hint_none: No model is called: digests list plain excerpts.
settings.model_hint_pick: Pick a provider whose key is present.
settings.model_intro: The models the next run calls, and how it uses your votes.
settings.no_area_table: No writable area table here — the areas live in the D1 store this deployment lacks.
settings.no_areas: No areas yet. Use "Propose areas from my sources" under Sources, or wait for the next run to suggest some.
settings.no_merge_target: No active area to merge into
settings.no_settings_store: This deployment has no settings store, so nothing can be saved here.
settings.no_sources: No sources yet. The next run waits until one is added.
settings.notifications_intro: Where a finished issue is announced.
settings.page_description: Settings for this Cyris deployment: model, digest, pipeline, notifications, sources and tracked topics.
settings.pipeline_intro: How far back each run looks, how much it reads, and where it cuts.
settings.save_unconfirmed: Could not confirm the save; showing what is stored.
settings.sender_match_hint: Maps a sender to this source; email routing itself stays in the Cloudflare dashboard.
settings.session_expired: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
settings.sources_intro: The feeds and newsletter senders the next run reads.
settings.threshold_saved: Birth threshold saved. It only marks proposals on this page.
settings.timezone_detected: Detected from this browser, and not saved yet.
settings.topic_description_hint: One sentence saying what the topic is about.
settings.topic_other_model: Set for {$model}; runs embed with {$current}, so it is skipped
settings.topic_threshold_hint: The cosine a title must reach, on that model's scale; there is no default. {#code}cyris topic-sim{/code} ranks the window's titles against the description: pick the lowest cosine still on topic.
settings.tracking_intro: Topics each issue lists every close article for, under Tracking; a topic set for another embedding model is skipped.
settings.unreachable: Could not reach cyris ({$error}). Check the connection and try again.
settings.vote_similarity_hint: Drop candidates close to an article you voted down. Preview what it would drop with {#code}cyris vote-sim{/code}; turning it on checks the embedder first.
settings.webhook_hint: To change it, paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists. Turn off clears it: runs then finish without a message.
settings_help.clef_needs_token: Clef needs a Workers AI token: set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN (or CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN).
settings_help.digest.max_articles_per_di: How many of the window's newest articles, by publish time, one run scores and digests across all sources.
settings_help.digest.output_language: The language headlines and summaries are written in.
settings_help.digest.preference_source: Who decides which items come first: your topic votes, or Clef reading the votes nearest each item. An issue Clef cannot fully score uses your topic votes.
settings_help.digest.rank_by_preference: Put first the items on topics you voted up, and on topics that share a name with them. The order only moves items; nothing is left out for it.
settings_help.digest.style_prompt: Your tone or focus for the summaries, in your own words; empty means none.
settings_help.digest.summarize_follow: Give each article from a source you follow a short explanation of what it is, as read articles get. Off shows the start of its own text.
settings_help.digest.topic_lifetime_days: Topics seen within this many days are current: new articles can join them, and a name many of them share counts for less in the order. An upvote slows how fast a topic leaves the list new articles can join; the effect fades with the vote half-life, and never lasts past three times this many days after the topic last appeared.
settings_help.digest.type_scale: How large the text is on every page. It applies within a minute, to issues already published too.
settings_help.digest.vote_half_life_days: A vote counts half as much after this many days, so a preference fades unless you vote again.
settings_help.general.digest_window_hour: How far back a run looks for articles.
settings_help.general.timezone: The clock the publish hours are read in.
settings_help.notify.email_from: An address on your Email Routing domain.
settings_help.notify.email_to: Leave it empty to send no mail. It must be a verified destination in Cloudflare Email Routing, and is saved once a test message reaches it.
settings_help.routing.score_threshold: Two or more articles on one topic scoring at least this share the Top story.
settings_help.snippet_lengths: How much of each article the model reads at each step; more costs more per call.
settings_help.vote_similarity.max_seeds: How many of your most recent votes on each side a run compares against.
settings_help.vote_similarity.model: Checked with one real call when vote similarity is on.
settings_help.vote_similarity.provider: The embedder vote similarity compares articles with. Its similarity cutoff comes with the model, so it is not set here.
vote.access_not_set_up: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.
vote.not_configured: Voting is not set up here: the app Worker has no CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL. Set it, then vote again.
vote.refused: The vote did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the promote Worker.
vote.signed_out: Your session has ended, so the vote was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.
vote.unanswered: No answer from the server, so the vote may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
